        "All 508 owned diff lines across three paths are read, including every changed handler hunk and both new tasks. Simple responses now decode using nsirequest.contentCharset with a UTF-8 default. XMLResponseHandler replaces per-chunk UTF-8 string decoding with raw byte chunks, combines them before decoding with channel charset, invalidates its cache on new data, and resets chunks/channel/cache between responses.",

The legacy path differs: its response proxy resolves responded at onStartRequest, while the async onStopRequest later awaits parsing. doWebDAVSync awaits commit, not that parsing promise.         "Comments/JSDoc casing/types and log prefixes also change. Explicit verbose guards are removed around debug calls, so the caller evaluates the response text before the logger decides output. For readability, the decoded-cache getter can return a non-null cached value first, then group allocation, chunk copying and decoding with clear blank lines; preserve empty-string caching and byte order. This is a scoped suggestion, not a decoder defect or global loop rule.",
